title: Efficient Fourier-Based Linear Combination of Unitaries and Applications in Quantum Optimization
summary: We investigate ancilla-free linear combination of unitaries (LCU) as a framework for approximating complex quantum circuits. This is particularly effective for quantum optimization algorithms, where candidate solutions can be evaluated classically and the task is to sample high-quality bitstrings rather than reproduce the full output distribution.
